michellenatasya.message: I know we ended up being friend in unexpected circumstances, but I am glad I have you in my hard days. Thank you for being in my life, and I wish we will continue become friends, til the end <3

alficopermana.name: Fico
alficopermana.message: Thank you fico, for being in my life. I know we didn't end in the best circumstances, but I am still greatful for all the things you gave me. Makasih yaa udah inget ultahku! (sori banget aku ga ngucapin kamu HAHA), I hope you the best for your life, work, love, and everything in between.
